annotations.annotation_provenance: Provisional visual annotations by the coding assistant on original video frames, 2026-11-22. Not human-adjudicated ground truth. Only the listed regions and pothole class are labeled; the rest of each image is unscored.

regions.note: Patterned, closed metal cover; no open pothole visible in this box.
Same cover one sampled frame later.
Same cover partly outside the frame.
Zebra crossing paint; no pothole visible within the selected paint region.
Long shadows crossing the road; no pothole visible in the selected strip.

unscored.note: Patch-like tonal variation; resolution and lighting do not establish whether it is a repair or damage. No negative label assigned. Requires human adjudication.

limitations: 0.60 is a requested starting threshold, not a validated optimum.
Four published RDD2022 test images, six boxes; not representative local validation.
Slideshow repeats those four still images: repeated frame counts are NOT independent samples or driving-tracking validation.
Road regions are provisional assistant visual labels, not human-adjudicated; only potholes with box centers inside annotated ROIs are scored.
Unannotated areas and ambiguous asphalt patches are excluded. Recall on negative-only ROIs is undefined.
Video selected after observing the error. This is a regression diagnostic, not a held-out benchmark.
Temporal stability can retain a persistent false positive and suppress a fast-moving real defect.
